FrieslandCampina WAMCO has appointed Chioma Otisi-Igwe as the new Marketing Manager of Peak, one of Nigeria’s leading dairy brands.
Her appointment comes after three successful years at the helm of Three Crowns’ marketing team, during which she spearheaded brand campaigns, deepened consumer engagement and helped drive the brand’s growth.
Reflecting on her tenure at Three Crowns, Otisi-Igwe expressed gratitude for the experience, achievements and professional relationships she built during the period, describing it as rewarding and memorable.
The appointment comes shortly after she was named Most Outstanding Dairy Professional of the Year by Brand Communicator, in recognition of her contributions to the dairy industry.
In her new position, Otisi-Igwe will lead Peak’s marketing operations, focusing on leveraging the brand’s longstanding heritage, deepening relationships with consumers and identifying avenues for sustainable growth.
Her transition from Three Crowns to Peak represents another significant step in her career, underscoring her continued contribution to brand development, marketing management and the Nigerian dairy sector.
